slides.say: After each render, React decides whether to re-run your Effect. Here is the exact rule.
React skips the Effect only if all dependencies have exactly the same values as during the previous render.

slides.code:
Object.is(3, 3)        // true  → same
Object.is("hi", "hi")  // true  → same
Object.is({}, {})      // false → changed
slides.say: It compares each one with Object dot is. Numbers and strings compare by value. But two objects are only the same if they are the very same object.

slides.text: One changed value is enough to re-run the Effect.
slides.say: If even one dependency differs, the Effect runs again.
